definitions.gloss: to arrange flowers, to do ikebana
definitions.explanation: To arrange cut flowers or branches in a vase or container, especially in the traditional Japanese art of flower arrangement (生け花).

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{毎週|まいしゅう}、{玄関|げんかん}に{花|はな}を{生|い}けている。
examples.english: My mother arranges flowers in the entryway every week.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}で{摘|つ}んだ{花|はな}を{和室|わしつ}の{花瓶|かびん}に{生|い}けた。
examples.english: I arranged flowers I picked from the garden in the vase in the Japanese-style room.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes を for the flowers being arranged.

RELATED WORDS:
- {生|い}け{花|ばな} / {生|い}け{花|はな}: ikebana, the art of flower arrangement
- {花瓶|かびん}: flower vase

WRITING:
Usually written as {生|い}ける. Also sometimes written as {活|い}ける with the same meaning.

NOTE: This is a different word from the colloquial いける (to be doable, to be okay).
